deals.name: Adidas
deals.summary: 30% off for verified military
deals.details: Covers active duty, veterans, retirees, spouses and dependents. Online limit 2 uses a month; in store and outlet 1 a month each. Many popular lines (e.g. Samba, Gazelle, Ultraboost, Stan Smith) and gift cards are excluded.
deals.howToClaim: Online: at checkout choose Verify with ID.me. In store/outlet: verify through ID.me first to get a one-time code to show at the register.
deals.notes: Guard/Reserve not named on page.

deals.name: American Airlines
deals.summary: Free checked bags for active duty
deals.details: Active U.S. military get up to 3 free bags (50 lb each) on personal trips; active duty and dependents on orders get up to 5 bags (100 lb each). Only on American-operated flights. Active duty with ID can also board in Group 1.
deals.howToClaim: Show active U.S. military ID at check-in.
deals.notes: Bag limits depend on destination. Dependents only covered when on orders. Military fares in some markets by phone.

deals.name: Amtrak
deals.summary: 10% off coach rail fares
deals.details: Applies to regular adult/child coach fares. Active duty, their spouses and dependents, and veterans qualify. California veterans and spouses get 15% on Pacific Surfliner, Capitol Corridor and San Joaquins. Not combinable with other discounts.
deals.howToClaim: When booking, pick the Military (Active), Military Veteran or Military (Dependent) traveler type; the discount applies automatically. Bring proof of status when traveling.
deals.notes: Page doesn't name Guard/Reserve or retirees, or list which ID documents count.

deals.name: Apple
deals.summary: 10% off through Apple's military online store
deals.details: Special online storefront for current and veteran members of the military, Guard and Reserve. Immediate family living in the same household also qualify. Not available in Apple Stores or the regular online store; Apple Card Monthly Installments not offered.
deals.howToClaim: Shop through Apple's Veterans and Military online store and verify with ID.me.
deals.notes: Retirees not named separately.

deals.name: Ariat
deals.summary: 10% off for you and your family
deals.details: For active duty, reserve, veteran and retired U.S. military. Valid on Ariat.com and at Ariat brand stores and outlets. Not on sale items or gift cards; can't combine with other offers.
deals.howToClaim: Create an Ariat Insider account and get verified on the military discount page; then log in to see the discount.
deals.notes: Current terms run 1/1/2026 to 12/31/2026; check for renewal. 'Family' not defined.

deals.name: AT&T
deals.summary: Up to 20% off unlimited wireless plans
deals.details: Monthly discount per line depends on plan: about 20% on Premium, 15% on Extra, 10% on Value. Up to 10 lines; the service member must be the primary account holder.
deals.howToClaim: Fill out AT&T's military verification form online or verify at an AT&T store; documents may be requested within 14 days.
deals.notes: Uses AT&T's own verification form (no outside service named). Retirees not named. Plan names change often; re-check percentages.

deals.name: Atkins
deals.summary: 10% off on the Atkins online shop
deals.details: Discount for active military and veterans (also first responders, teachers, nurses and medical providers).
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me on Atkins' military discount page.
deals.notes: Page text says 10% but a banner image says 15% every day; confirm the amount.

deals.name: Audi
deals.summary: $1,000 toward a new Audi
deals.details: Credit toward the lease or purchase of select new Audi models for current service members, retirees, veterans and military family members.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me through Audi's Military Select Program, then go to an Audi dealer.
deals.notes: Eligible models and end date not stated; confirm with the dealer.

deals.name: AutoZone
deals.summary: 10% off in-store purchases
deals.details: For active and retired members of all branches, including the Army and Air National Guard, plus dependents. Not valid on AutoZone.com or in the app.
deals.howToClaim: Show a military ID or other accepted proof (DoD ID, VA ID card, DD-214, dependent ID) at the register.
deals.notes: Page names active and retired; it accepts veteran IDs as proof but doesn't say plainly that all veterans qualify.

deals.name: Avis
deals.summary: Up to 35% off Pay Now rentals (WeSalute+)
deals.details: For veterans, active duty, Guard and Reserve, and immediate family. Applies to time and mileage only. Some car groups, blackout dates and locations excluded.
deals.howToClaim: Enroll in WeSalute+, then add the AWD number when booking on Avis.
deals.notes: Requires WeSalute+ enrollment; page doesn't say if it's free or paid.

deals.name: Bass Pro Shops
deals.summary: 10% off most items
deals.details: Discount on eligible merchandise for verified military (also offered to some first responders).
deals.howToClaim: In store: show ID proving military status. Online: create an account and submit verification.
deals.notes: Page doesn't specify which military groups qualify.

deals.name: Big 5 Sporting Goods
deals.summary: 10% off your entire purchase in store
deals.details: For active duty and reserve, retirees, veterans, and their spouses and dependent children. Gift cards and licenses excluded; can't combine with other coupons.
deals.howToClaim: Show a military ID or a driver's license showing veteran status at the register.
deals.notes: Big 5 stores are in the western U.S.

deals.name: Big Lots
deals.summary: Extra 10% off almost everything in store
deals.details: Every day for active military and retired veterans.
deals.howToClaim: Join Big Rewards, then give the cashier your Rewards email or phone plus a valid military or veteran ID.
deals.notes: Wording says 'retired Veteran' so it's unclear if all veterans qualify. Big Lots closed many stores in 2024-25; check store availability.

deals.name: BJ's Wholesale Club
deals.summary: Membership for $25 (reg. $60) plus $10 reward
deals.details: Club membership $25 or Club+ $50 for the first year, with a reward to use within 30 days. Covers active duty incl. Guard/Reserve, veterans, retirees, spouses, surviving spouses and adult children/parents. New members only.
deals.howToClaim: Sign up at BJs.com/Military and verify with ID.me.
deals.notes: Auto-renews at full price. BJ's clubs are mostly in the East.

deals.name: BMW
deals.summary: $500 to $5,000 toward a new BMW
deals.details: Incentive on most new BMW models for active duty, Guard, Reserve, veterans, retirees, spouses, surviving spouses and immediate family. Amount varies by model. Not combinable with BMW Corporate Sales.
deals.howToClaim: Pick a vehicle on BMW's military page, click Claim Offer, verify with ID.me, and give the emailed offer code to your BMW dealer.
deals.notes: End date not stated; amounts change by model.

deals.name: Bonefish Grill
deals.summary: 10% off your check every day
deals.details: For active duty, veterans, retirees and their immediate family (also first responders). Excludes alcohol, gift cards, tip and tax.
deals.howToClaim: Show valid military ID, DD-214, VA ID card, or similar proof. For online orders, choose pay at restaurant and tell staff at pickup.
deals.notes: Can't combine with Dine Rewards, AARP or Prix Fixe meals.

deals.name: Bonobos
deals.summary: 20% off for current military
deals.details: Military discount for current service members in the US and Canada.
deals.howToClaim: Sign up through the verification link on Bonobos' promotional offers page.
deals.notes: Page says current military only; doesn't say online vs store or name groups.

deals.name: Boot Barn
deals.summary: 10% off full-price styles
deals.details: Discount for military members (also first responders). Not on sale items or gift cards; can't combine with other offers.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me in your cart.
deals.notes: Page doesn't specify which military groups qualify or whether it works in stores.

deals.name: Boscov's
deals.summary: Up to 15% off, even during sales
deals.details: Code good for one year, in any store and online, for active, reserve and veteran members of all branches including the National Guard, NOAA and USPHS.
deals.howToClaim: Complete Boscov's online military discount application to get your code.
deals.notes: Some exclusions apply (not listed). Verification method not named.

deals.name: Bose
deals.summary: 10% off, up to $100 off
deals.details: Discount on Bose.com for military personnel and veterans. Military can also buy aviation headsets through a separate program.
deals.howToClaim: Click Verify with ID.me at checkout; the discount applies automatically.
deals.notes: Aviation headsets: email Bose's military headset team.

deals.name: Brooks Running
deals.summary: 25% off online, 3 codes a year
deals.details: Community Heroes program for military (also nurses and first responders). Up to three single-use codes per rolling 12 months. Sale items, some lifestyle collections and runDisney excluded. U.S. shipping only.
deals.howToClaim: Sign in or create an ID.me account on Brooks' Community Heroes page to get codes.
deals.notes: Page doesn't specify which military groups qualify. Not valid in stores or at other retailers.

deals.name: Busch Gardens Tampa Bay
deals.summary: Free yearly admission for active duty plus 3 dependents (Waves of Honor)
deals.details: One free visit per year to one participating park for active duty, activated or drilling Reserve and Guard, plus up to three direct dependents. Also 50% off up to six extra single-day tickets, and an active-duty annual pass.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me on the park's military page, get the e-ticket, and show military ID at the gate.
deals.notes: Retirees and inactive reserve excluded. Offer dates run to 12/31/2026; check for the 2027 renewal.

deals.name: Cabela's
deals.summary: 10% off most items
deals.details: Discount on eligible merchandise for verified military (also some first responders).
deals.howToClaim: In store: show ID proving military status. Online: sign in and submit verification.
deals.notes: Page doesn't specify which military groups qualify. Same program as Bass Pro Shops.

deals.name: Carhartt
deals.summary: 15% off apparel and accessories
deals.details: Discount for military members (also first responders and nurses) with valid ID.
deals.howToClaim: Show valid ID; page gives no other steps.
deals.notes: Page doesn't specify which military groups qualify, or whether it's online, in store or both.

deals.name: Carnival Cruise Line
deals.summary: Military cruise rates on sailings 2026 to 2029
deals.details: Carnival says U.S. and Canadian military members and veterans always get a military discount; search military fares on its deals page.
deals.howToClaim: Use the military cruise search on Carnival's military deals page.
deals.notes: Page gives no discount amount or proof requirements.

deals.name: Casper
deals.summary: Extra 5% off everything
deals.details: For active duty, retirees, veterans, military spouses and family members (including parents and children of veterans). Not on clearance or final sale; can't combine with other offers.
deals.howToClaim: Click Verify with ID.me on Casper's military page to get a promo code for checkout.
deals.notes: Page only covers online use.

deals.name: Choice Hotels
deals.summary: Military leisure rate at participating hotels
deals.details: Special leisure-travel rate for active duty and veterans (and dependents) at participating Choice brands. A separate rate covers official travel.
deals.howToClaim: Join Choice Privileges (free), add your branch and status to your account, then pick the military leisure rate when booking.
deals.notes: No discount amount stated. Eligible person must stay in the room.

deals.name: Cinemark
deals.summary: Military ticket pricing at participating theatres
deals.details: Discounted tickets for active duty, active reserve, retired military and dependents at participating Cinemark theatres. Special engagements excluded.
deals.howToClaim: Show a valid U.S. government military ID at the box office.
deals.notes: Amount varies by theatre and not all theatres take part; check the local theatre.

deals.name: Columbia
deals.summary: 10% off on Columbia.com
deals.details: For active duty, veterans, retirees and their spouses and dependents.
deals.howToClaim: In the cart, open the promo code drawer and choose Verify with ID.me.
deals.notes: Page only covers online use; Guard/Reserve not named.

deals.name: Crocs
deals.summary: 15% off select styles
deals.details: Military discount on select Crocs styles.
deals.howToClaim: Verify your status with ID.me on Crocs' military page.
deals.notes: Page doesn't specify which military groups qualify. Exclusions apply.

deals.name: Dave & Buster's
deals.summary: 15% off food and non-alcoholic drinks
deals.details: Discount with valid military ID (also first responders) for up to four guests. Excludes games, alcohol, gift cards, tax and tip.
deals.howToClaim: Show a valid military ID to your server.
deals.notes: Participating locations only. Page doesn't specify which military groups qualify.

deals.name: Dell
deals.summary: Up to 10% extra off on Dell.com
deals.details: For active duty, veterans and retirees. Limit 2 eligible products per order and 2 orders a year. Doesn't stack with other Dell coupons; clearance, gift cards and some items excluded.
deals.howToClaim: Sign in, join Dell Rewards, and verify in the membership section.

deals.name: Delta Air Lines
deals.summary: Extra free checked bags and military fares for active duty
deals.details: Active duty members of all branches get more free checked bags than civilians, plus savings on fares booked through Delta.
deals.howToClaim: Message or call Delta reservations to book military fares; bag allowance applies at check-in.
deals.notes: Page doesn't say how many bags or how much fares are discounted; see Delta's baggage fees page.

deals.name: DISH
deals.summary: Free Stars & Stripes channel pack and 2-year price lock
deals.details: Military offer adds a channel pack (about $240 value over 2 years), one free On Demand rental a month and a 2-year price guarantee. New customers, 2-year contract.
deals.howToClaim: Sign up for DISH's military offer online or by phone.
deals.notes: Page doesn't say who qualifies or how status is checked. Early termination fee applies.

deals.name: Disneyland Resort
deals.summary: Specially priced military tickets for 2027
deals.details: Military promo tickets: 1-day tickets valid Oct 6, 2026 to Dec 30, 2027; 3- and 4-day tickets valid all of 2027. A 2026 offer is also still listed.
deals.howToClaim: Buy at a military base ticket office or through GovX.
deals.notes: Page doesn't give prices or say which military groups qualify.

deals.name: Dollar Rent A Car
deals.summary: 5% off leisure rentals plus a free upgrade
deals.details: Government and military leisure rate with a free car-class upgrade and unlimited mileage, using CDP 3031396.
deals.howToClaim: Book on Dollar's government leisure page; code CDP 3031396 is filled in.
deals.notes: Page doesn't specify which military groups qualify or what ID is needed.

deals.name: Dollywood
deals.summary: Discounted military tickets and season passes
deals.details: Special prices for active and retired military, veterans, reservists, spouses and dependents. 2026 day tickets and 2027 season passes (e.g. Silver pass from $141.49 + tax).
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me, then buy in your My Dollywood account. Pick up season pass cards at the Front Gate.
deals.notes: Prices change by season.

deals.name: Embrace Pet Insurance
deals.summary: 5% off pet insurance
deals.details: Discount on any Embrace plan for active duty, veterans and eligible family members.
deals.howToClaim: See Embrace's discounts page for details.
deals.notes: Page doesn't say how status is checked.

deals.name: EyeBuyDirect
deals.summary: 20% off eyewear orders
deals.details: Military discount on EyeBuyDirect.com, verified at checkout.
deals.howToClaim: Verify your military status at checkout.
deals.notes: Page text says 20% but its breadcrumb says 30%. Groups and verification method not stated.

deals.name: Eyemart Express
deals.summary: 20% off glasses every day
deals.details: For active, non-active, retired military and veterans, plus dependents with a military dependent ID. Covers eyeglasses and sunglasses; not eye exams or contacts. Oakley, Ray-Ban and ready-to-wear sunglasses excluded.
deals.howToClaim: Show a military ID, DD-214 or state ID at checkout in store. For dependents, the service member must be present.
deals.notes: Usually can't be combined with insurance.

deals.name: Fanatics
deals.summary: 15% off all orders plus free shipping
deals.details: For active duty, National Guard, veterans, retirees, spouses and dependents. Free ground shipping incl. APO/FPO. Not on gift cards; can't combine with other codes.
deals.howToClaim: At checkout click the Troop ID (ID.me) button to verify.
deals.notes: Reserve not named (Guard is).

deals.name: FIGS
deals.summary: 15% off most scrubs and products
deals.details: For active, veteran and retired service members with a U.S. service record from 9/30/1985 on, plus USAA members.
deals.howToClaim: At checkout click Military Discount and complete verification.
deals.notes: Page doesn't name the verification service; FIGS help pages mention ID.me.

deals.name: Foot Locker
deals.summary: 10% off most purchases
deals.details: For active duty, veterans, National Guard, reservists, and registered dependents of active-duty or retired members. Max $100 off per verification. Some products excluded.
deals.howToClaim: In store: show valid military or photo ID. Online: choose military discount in the payment step and verify.
deals.notes: Page covers Foot Locker only, not Champs or Kids Foot Locker.

deals.name: Fox Nation
deals.summary: Free first year, then 50% off renewals
deals.details: Military plan for people who have served or are serving in the U.S. Armed Forces.
deals.howToClaim: Sign up on the Fox Nation military page and verify (documents may be needed). Cancel 24 hours before renewal to avoid charges.
deals.notes: Payment method required up front.

deals.name: GameStop
deals.summary: 10% off most merchandise in store
deals.details: For active military. Covers items like toys, collectibles and pre-owned products. New games, consoles, accessories, PC hardware, gift cards and sale items excluded.
deals.howToClaim: Show a military ID or DD-214 in store.
deals.notes: Page title mentions veterans but the terms only name active military.

deals.name: GEICO
deals.summary: Up to 15% off car insurance
deals.details: Discount for active duty, retirees, and Guard/Reserve, plus an emergency deployment discount.
deals.howToClaim: See GEICO's military discounts page.
deals.notes: Veterans and family not named.

deals.name: GoPro
deals.summary: 5% off GoPro products
deals.details: For verified military and veterans on GoPro.com (U.S. only).
deals.howToClaim: Click Verify with ID.me on GoPro's discount page; the discount applies in your cart.
deals.notes: Restrictions apply (not listed).

deals.name: Great Wolf Lodge
deals.summary: Up to 40% off stays (Howling Heroes)
deals.details: For active, retired and veteran military (and other public servants). Standard suites only; book and stay by 12/31/2028; blackouts may apply.
deals.howToClaim: Log in with ID.me and book with promo code GWLHEROES.
deals.notes: Not valid at Niagara, Ontario. Other lodges have the same offer page.

deals.name: Harley-Davidson
deals.summary: $500 Customer Cash or $250 parts credit on select new bikes
deals.details: 'Your Service, Our Thanks' offer for active, reservist and veteran military, plus free military shipping on eligible items and a military financing program for active duty.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me to get an offer code, then bring it to a participating dealer.
deals.notes: Page doesn't say if the cash and parts credit can be combined, or when the offer ends.

deals.name: Helly Hansen
deals.summary: Military pro pricing online (1-year membership)
deals.details: Approved active duty, reservist, veteran and retired military get a discount on Helly Hansen and HH Workwear online.
deals.howToClaim: Apply on Helly Hansen's military program page with proof showing your name and current date (not a photo of a military ID).
deals.notes: Page doesn't state the discount amount. Approval usually within 48 business hours.

deals.name: Helzberg Diamonds
deals.summary: 10% off online, in store or by phone
deals.details: For active duty, military retirees, disabled veterans and registered dependents of active duty or retirees. Not on clearance, sale, outlet, repairs or care plans.
deals.howToClaim: Click Verify Now on Helzberg's special discounts page, or show eligible ID in store.
deals.notes: Veterans: only disabled veterans are named.

deals.name: Hertz
deals.summary: Up to 20% off base rates with Military Brands code
deals.details: Use CDP 2306779 for up to 20% off pay-later base rates at airport and neighborhood locations, plus a free additional driver. Book 24 hours ahead; not combinable with other offers.
deals.howToClaim: Book on Hertz with discount code (CDP) 2306779.
deals.notes: Page doesn't specify which military groups qualify or how status is checked.

deals.name: HexClad
deals.summary: 10% off cookware
deals.details: For current and veteran members of the military, Guard and Reserve, and immediate family (also police, fire, EMTs). One discount per order; not with Black Friday/Cyber Monday sales.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me on the HexClad Heroes page to get a code that applies at checkout.

deals.name: Hilton
deals.summary: Military Family Rate on leisure stays
deals.details: Discount varies by hotel for active duty, reserve, retired service members, veterans, and spouses and families (U.S. and Canada). Leisure stays only.
deals.howToClaim: Book the Military Family Rate online or call 1-800-HONORS. Show valid military ID at check-in.
deals.notes: Amount varies by hotel.

deals.name: HOKA
deals.summary: 15% or more off on hoka.com
deals.details: Discount for military personnel (also medical, first responders, teachers, students).
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me at checkout on hoka.com.
deals.notes: Page doesn't specify which military groups qualify or list exclusions.

deals.name: Home Depot
deals.summary: 10% off eligible items
deals.details: Everyday discount for veterans, active service members and spouses.
deals.howToClaim: Register and verify online so your account shows military status, then show it in the app at checkout or shop online while signed in.
deals.notes: Exclusions not listed on that page.

deals.name: HP
deals.summary: Up to 40% off at HP's Frontline Heroes store
deals.details: For military, veterans and their families (also first responders and healthcare). Yearly limits apply (e.g. 2 PCs, 2 printers, 10 accessories). Ink and toner excluded.
deals.howToClaim: Register for the Frontline Heroes store on hp.com and verify with ID.me.

deals.name: Hyatt
deals.summary: 10% to 15% off standard rates
deals.details: At participating U.S. Hyatt hotels for veterans, active duty and immediate family traveling with them.
deals.howToClaim: Book with offer code MILVET. Show military or veteran ID or DD-214 at check-in.
deals.notes: Participating hotels only.

deals.name: Hyundai
deals.summary: $500 bonus toward a new Hyundai
deals.details: For active duty, Guard/Reserve, veterans, retirees and spouses, on all new models. Valid Jan 7 to Dec 31, 2026. Not with Hyundai Circle or First Responders program.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me through Hyundai's military program page, then buy or lease at a dealer.
deals.notes: Check for a 2027 renewal.

deals.name: IHG Hotels & Resorts
deals.summary: Military leisure rate, at least 5% off
deals.details: At participating IHG hotels for U.S. and Canadian active duty, veterans, retired military and family. Leisure only; blackout dates apply.
deals.howToClaim: Book the military leisure rate on IHG and show military or veteran ID at check-in.
deals.notes: Not at IHG Army Hotels. Amount varies by hotel.

deals.name: iRobot
deals.summary: Up to 15% off select robot vacuums and mops
deals.details: Limited-time discount for military members (also first responders and nurses) on select robots. Can't combine with other offers.
deals.howToClaim: Verify through the ID.me link on iRobot's military page.
deals.notes: Page calls it a limited-time offer with no end date; groups not specified.

deals.name: Kohl's
deals.summary: 15% off in store on Mondays
deals.details: For active military, veterans, retirees and immediate family. Can't be combined with other percent-off coupons; Sephora at Kohl's, gift cards and some brands excluded.
deals.howToClaim: Show a military ID, a state ID showing veteran status, or a DD-214 at the register on a Monday.
deals.notes: Mondays only.

deals.name: LASIKPlus
deals.summary: 20% off LASIK
deals.details: For veterans, active duty, reserves and military families/spouses at participating LasikPlus centers. Can't combine with other offers.
deals.howToClaim: Bring proof of service to your appointment.
deals.notes: Page doesn't list which documents count.

deals.name: LEGOLAND California
deals.summary: Military savings on tickets and up to 10% off hotel
deals.details: Standing military discount on 1-day and Resort Hopper tickets (2nd day free) and up to 10% off LEGOLAND hotel rooms, for active duty, retirees, veterans, spouses and dependents.
deals.howToClaim: Buy through LEGOLAND California's military offers page. Show military/DoD or government ID at hotel check-in.
deals.notes: Ticket discount amount not stated. Park reservation required.

deals.name: Levi's
deals.summary: 10% off at Levi.com
deals.details: For active and retired U.S. military. Up to two single-use codes per 365 days. Can't combine with promos over 40% off.
deals.howToClaim: Fill out the SheerID military form on Levi's help page to get a code for checkout.
deals.notes: Veterans and family not named.

deals.name: LG Electronics
deals.summary: At least 10% below LG.com sale prices
deals.details: LG Appreciation Program for military and veterans, with free installation on select TVs and appliances. Quantities limited.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me, then create an LG Partner Store account.

deals.name: LinkedIn
deals.summary: Free 12 months of LinkedIn Premium
deals.details: One-time Premium offer for veterans, active duty and military spouses who take part in career services from Hire Heroes USA, Student Veterans of America or Hiring Our Heroes. First come, first served.
deals.howToClaim: Enroll in career services with one of LinkedIn's partner nonprofits, which give out the offer.
deals.notes: Can't already have Premium. Limited number of offers.

deals.name: Logitech
deals.summary: 20% off your next purchase
deals.details: For active military, veterans and their families (also students, teachers, medical, first responders).
deals.howToClaim: Click Verify Military Status on Logitech's SheerID page.
deals.notes: Page doesn't say if it's reusable or list exclusions.

deals.name: Lowe's
deals.summary: 10% off eligible purchases
deals.details: For active duty, National Guard, honorably discharged veterans and their verified spouses. Free MyLowe's Rewards Silver upgrade. No yearly cap. Not valid on sale items, major appliances, gift cards, installs and some other items.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me through MyLowe's Rewards. Online it applies when signed in; in store give your phone number and photo ID.
deals.notes: Retirees not named separately.

deals.name: Lululemon
deals.summary: 15% off online and in store
deals.details: For active military, spouses and dependents in the same household, reservists and veterans. Good for 4 years, no use limit. Not on Like New, gift cards or prior purchases.
deals.howToClaim: Get verified online, then sign in to use it online, or ask an educator in store and show ID.
deals.notes: Retirees not named. Spouse/family: of active duty.

deals.name: Marcus Theatres
deals.summary: $8.50 movie tickets
deals.details: Any-time price for active and retired military at participating Marcus theatres. Extra charge for premium formats; not for special events.
deals.howToClaim: Show official military ID at the box office.
deals.notes: Fine print says 'limited time only' with no end date. Marcus theatres are mostly in the Midwest.

deals.name: Marriott Vacation Club
deals.summary: 15% off flexible rates
deals.details: At participating Marriott, Westin and Sheraton Vacation Club resorts (U.S., Caribbean, Mexico) for active, Reserve, retired military and National Guard. Two rooms per ID per night.
deals.howToClaim: Book online or call 1-800-228-9290 with promo code XYD. Show military ID at check-in.
deals.notes: Covers Vacation Club resorts only, not all Marriott hotels.

deals.name: Mattress Firm
deals.summary: 10% to 20% off top mattress and bedding brands
deals.details: For active and reservist military, veterans, military spouses and more.
deals.howToClaim: See Mattress Firm's military discount page.
deals.notes: Page doesn't say how to verify or whether it's online or in store.
