deals.details: Free app lets military parents record video of themselves reading a book so kids can watch any time. Free books can be ordered for recordings.
deals.howToClaim: Download the United Through Reading app and verify with ID.me.
deals.notes: Open to military families and veterans of any duty status.

deals.name: USO (spouse and family programs)
deals.summary: Free spouse meetups, baby showers and reading program
deals.details: Free programs include Coffee Connections spouse meetups (in person and live online), Special Delivery baby showers, a reading program for video story messages, and free virtual events.
deals.howToClaim: Sign up on uso.org/milspouse or at a local USO center.
deals.notes: Formal eligibility not listed on page; offerings vary by USO location.

deals.name: Hug-A-Hero dolls (Red Cross Southern California)
deals.summary: Dolls with a deploying parent's photo for kids
deals.details: Red Cross Southern California Region arranges dolls printed with a deploying service member's photo for their children. Units deploying 6+ months request them through the Red Cross.
deals.howToClaim: Unit representatives request dolls through the Red Cross Southern California Region.
deals.notes: 2023 article; page says program is unique to Southern California and doesn't confirm cost to families.

deals.name: Child Care Aware of America (military fee assistance)
deals.summary: Help paying for off-base child care
deals.details: Fee assistance lowers off-base child care costs for families without access to on-base care (MCCYN). Army, Navy, Air Force/Space Force (ages 0-12) and Marine Corps programs run through Child Care Aware; Navy also has EFMP respite care.
deals.howToClaim: Apply through MilitaryChildCare.com (MCCYN) or your branch's fee assistance page.
deals.notes: Air Force EFMP respite moved to the Department of the Air Force on Oct 1, 2026. Coast Guard and Guard/Reserve rules not on this page (Bright Horizons page says Navy runs MCCYN for Coast Guard).

deals.name: Bright Horizons
deals.summary: Registration fee waived (up to $150 per child)
deals.details: One-time registration fee waiver up to $150 per child at participating centers for families eligible for MCCYN fee assistance. Can combine with sibling and new-family discounts. Army families' annual fees are reimbursed by the Army.
deals.howToClaim: Confirm MCCYN eligibility, find a participating center, and enter code MILITARY at registration.
deals.notes: Covers Army, Air Force, Marine Corps, Navy and Coast Guard per page. Child can't have been enrolled in the last 90 days.

deals.name: Air Force Aid Society: Give Parents a Break
deals.summary: $40 per child per month toward child care, up to 3 months
deals.details: Child care money for Air Force and Space Force families under stress (deployments, remote tours, moves): $40 per dependent child per month for up to 3 months, usable at any child care option, paid by Zelle or ACH.
deals.howToClaim: Get a GPAB certificate from your commander, first sergeant, chaplain, medical provider, Family Advocacy or M&FRC, then apply on the AFAS portal with your military ID.
deals.notes: Air Force and Space Force only. Guard/Reserve only when on Title 10 orders over 15 days.

deals.name: Tutor.com for U.S. Military Families
deals.summary: Free 24/7 online tutoring for kids and spouses
deals.details: Free one-on-one online tutoring and test prep in 150+ subjects, any time. Covers K-12 and college students in military families and the service members themselves.
deals.howToClaim: Sign in or create an account at military.tutor.com.
deals.notes: DoD-funded. Covers Army, Navy, Air Force, Space Force, Marine Corps incl. Guard/Reserve. Coast Guard not listed on FAQ. Retirees not eligible.

deals.name: Boys & Girls Clubs of America (Mission: Youth Outreach)
deals.summary: Free or reduced club membership for military kids
deals.details: Kids of active duty, Guard and Reserve members (all branches incl. Coast Guard and Space Force) can get free or reduced-fee membership at participating clubs. Camps and trips may still cost extra.
deals.howToClaim: Enroll online at bgca.org/military, then bring the confirmation email and military ID to your local club.
deals.notes: Ages listed as 5-18 (one FAQ says 6-18). Some veteran and Gold Star families may qualify. Depends on local funding.

deals.name: Our Military Kids
deals.summary: Up to $300 activity grants for kids of deployed Guard/Reserve
deals.details: Grants pay for sports, arts, camps, tutoring and similar activities for kids ages 1-18. Deployed Guard/Reserve (60+ days): one $300 grant for 60-179 days, two for 180+ days. Also serves kids of post-9/11 combat-injured members and veterans.
deals.howToClaim: Apply online at ourmilitarykids.org with orders, child ID (DEERS form or birth certificate) and proof of activity cost.
deals.notes: Active duty only qualifies under the combat-injured program. Activity must start before the member returns. Checks go to the activity provider.

deals.name: Operation Purple Camp (NMFA)
deals.summary: Free week of summer camp for military kids
deals.details: Free summer camps for kids of all uniformed services incl. Guard and Reserve, with priority for families facing deployments, injuries and frequent moves. $25 refundable deposit; families pay travel.
deals.howToClaim: Apply during the spring window on militaryfamily.org (2026 window was Feb 11 to Mar 11).
deals.notes: 2027 dates not yet posted. Selection isn't first-come. Free virtual Summer Challenge for ages 6-14.

deals.name: Operation Homefront Back-to-School Brigade
deals.summary: Free school supplies for military kids
deals.details: Free school supplies for DEERS-enrolled military kids in grades K-12 at summer events near bases. All ranks of active duty, Guard and Reserve, plus post-9/11 wounded, ill or injured members.
deals.howToClaim: Register for an event near you on operationhomefront.org (events fill up).
deals.notes: Events run each summer (e.g. July 18, 2026 in Killeen, TX).

deals.name: Armed Services YMCA
deals.summary: Free and low-cost family programs, focus on junior enlisted
deals.details: Programs include Operation Hero (free after-school help for kids adjusting to change), Operation Kid Comfort (photo quilts and pillows for kids of deployed parents), free child care in some military hospital waiting rooms, camps, holiday meals and travel help for junior enlisted.
deals.howToClaim: Contact your local Armed Services YMCA branch.
deals.notes: Page doesn't list eligibility or costs per program; availability depends on local branch.

deals.name: Sesame Street for Military Families
deals.summary: Free videos and tools for kids during deployments and moves
deals.details: Free bilingual videos, apps, printables and tips for kids ages 2-8 about deployment, homecoming, moving, grief and big feelings.
deals.howToClaim: Go to sesamestreetformilitaryfamilies.org.
deals.notes: Open to anyone; built for active-duty and veteran families.

deals.name: Scholarships for Military Children
deals.summary: 500 college scholarships of $2,000
deals.details: Fisher House and commissary program awards at least one $2,000 scholarship per commissary with applicants. Unmarried dependents under 23 of active, Guard/Reserve, retired or deceased members (incl. Coast Guard and Space Force). Min 3.0 GPA for high schoolers.
deals.howToClaim: Apply online at the Fisher House scholarship site between Dec 9, 2026 and Feb 10, 2027 (9 p.m. MST). 500-word essay required.
deals.notes: For the 2027-2028 school year.

deals.name: Army Emergency Relief scholarships
deals.summary: College aid for Army spouses and children
deals.details: Need-based scholarships: Patty Shinseki program for spouses (first degree or certification, apply year-round) and Ursano program for children under 24 (window was Jan 1 to Apr 1, 2026). Amounts vary each year.
deals.howToClaim: Apply on armyemergencyrelief.org with a FAFSA Submission Summary; dependent must be in DEERS.
deals.notes: Army only. Guard/Reserve eligibility depends on status. Children's window is seasonal.

deals.name: National Park Service Military Annual Pass
deals.summary: Free annual pass to national parks and federal lands
deals.details: Free annual pass for current military and their dependents covers entrance and day-use fees at national parks and other federal lands for the holder plus one car. Camping and tours not included.
deals.howToClaim: Get it free at a park with CAC or dependent ID, free digital pass on Recreation.gov, or by mail from USGS ($10 fee).
deals.notes: Dependents can get their own annual pass. Veterans and Gold Star families get a free lifetime pass. Guard/Reserve not named for the annual pass.

deals.name: Blue Star Museums
deals.summary: Free museum admission for military families each summer
deals.details: Free admission at 2,000+ participating museums, zoos, aquariums and gardens for currently serving members (all branches incl. Guard and Reserve) plus up to 5 family members. The 2026 season ran May 16 to Sept 7.
deals.howToClaim: Show CAC and dependent ID at a participating museum (list and map at arts.gov/bluestarmuseums).
deals.notes: Runs Armed Forces Day to Labor Day each year; 2027 dates not yet announced. Veterans not included.

deals.name: Operation Homefront Star-Spangled Babies
deals.summary: Free baby showers with baby supplies
deals.details: Free baby showers near bases where new military moms receive baby supplies and local resources.
deals.howToClaim: Find an event by state on operationhomefront.org.
deals.notes: Page says only 'for new military moms'; pay grade and branch rules not listed.

deals.name: NMCRS Budget for Baby
deals.summary: Free baby budgeting class with gifts for Navy and Marine families
deals.details: Free 90-minute class on budgeting for a new baby, with gifts for attendees. Open to all ranks of active and retired Sailors and Marines, spouses with ID, surviving spouses, and reservists on 30+ days active duty. Not limited to first pregnancies.
deals.howToClaim: Find an in-person or virtual workshop on nmcrs.org or contact your NMCRS office.
deals.notes: Navy and Marine Corps only. Coast Guard site says this class also provides a layette.

deals.name: Air Force Aid Society Bundles for Babies
deals.summary: Free new-parent class plus a gift card for baby items
deals.details: Free class for expecting Air Force families covering finances, infant care and resources. Attendees get a free AFAS gift card toward newborn items. All ranks, not just first pregnancies.
deals.howToClaim: Contact your Airman & Family Readiness Center to sign up.
deals.notes: Page names active-duty Air Force; Space Force and Guard/Reserve not addressed. Gift card amount not stated.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance Welcome Baby Layettes
deals.summary: Free baby backpack for Coast Guard families
deals.details: Free backpack of baby essentials (onesies, burp cloths, sippy cup) for Coast Guard families who are expecting, adopting, or have a baby under 6 months. Covers active duty, reserves, retirees, auxiliary, civilians and surviving spouses.
deals.howToClaim: Apply on the CGMA portal with your Coast Guard ID, or ask your local CGMA representative.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only.

deals.name: New Parent Support Program
deals.summary: Free home visits and parenting help for new military parents
deals.details: Free, voluntary home visits and parenting education for expecting parents and families with young kids (age 3 and under for Army, Navy and Air Force; 5 and under for Marine Corps).
deals.howToClaim: Enroll through your installation's Family Advocacy Program or Military and Family Support Center.
deals.notes: Requires access to a military treatment facility. Families far from a base can use Military OneSource new-parent consultations.

deals.name: TRICARE breast pumps and supplies
deals.summary: Breast pump and supplies at no cost
deals.details: TRICARE covers one manual or standard electric pump per birth plus replacement supplies (like 100 storage bags every 30 days) for up to 3 years. No cost through network suppliers.
deals.howToClaim: Get a prescription from a TRICARE-authorized provider and order from a network supplier.
deals.notes: Eligible from 27 weeks pregnant, after birth, or after adopting an infant. Out-of-network purchases are reimbursed up to the allowed amount.

deals.name: Happiest Baby (SNOO)
deals.summary: 20% off SNOO smart bassinet
deals.details: Military discount of 20% off a new SNOO Smart Sleeper. Can't be combined with other offers; Pre-Loved and rental SNOOs excluded.
deals.howToClaim: Use the Get Discount button on happiestbaby.com/pages/military.
deals.notes: Page doesn't say who qualifies or which verification service is used.

deals.name: Healthybaby
deals.summary: 15% off diapers and baby products
deals.details: 15% off all orders for current and former military, military spouses and dependents (also first responders and government workers).
deals.howToClaim: Verify with GovX ID at healthybaby.com/pages/military-discount to get a single-use code.
deals.notes: Help-center page; no exclusions listed. Guard/Reserve not named.

deals.name: Strolleria
deals.summary: Military discount on strollers and car seats
deals.details: Discount on strollers, car seats and gear from select brands (e.g. UPPAbaby, Stokke, Maxi-Cosi) for active and retired members and their families. Not on sale items or accessories.
deals.howToClaim: Email or chat with Strolleria with the items you want plus a .mil email or proof of service. Phone 888-496-6718.
deals.notes: Discount amount not stated; some brands' pricing rules block it.

deals.name: Melissa & Doug
deals.summary: 15% off select toys
deals.details: 15% off select products for active duty incl. Guard and Reserve, veterans, retirees, military spouses and adult family members. Excludes sale items, furniture, gift cards and bundles.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me; the discount applies at checkout.
deals.notes: Covers all branches incl. Coast Guard and Space Force.

deals.name: SpouseWorks Scholarship (formerly MyCAA)
deals.summary: Up to $4,000 for spouse licenses, certificates and associate degrees
deals.details: DoD money for spouses to earn a license, certification or associate degree, or take continuing-ed courses needed to keep a license. Military OneSource now says it is open across all ranks and pay grades.
deals.howToClaim: Create an account on mycaa.militaryonesource.mil; free career coaching at 800-342-9647.
deals.notes: Army, Marine Corps, Navy, Air Force and Space Force; Guard/Reserve on qualifying Title 10 orders; Coast Guard not listed.

deals.name: Spouse relicensing and business cost reimbursement
deals.summary: Up to $1,000 for relicensing plus $1,000 for business costs per PCS
deals.details: After a PCS across state lines, spouses can be reimbursed up to $1,000 for a new professional license or certification, and separately up to $1,000 for moving a spouse-owned business.
deals.howToClaim: Submit SF 1034, PCS orders, old and new license, receipts and marriage certificate through your branch's process.
deals.notes: DoD-wide benefit, but each branch runs its own process (Navy, Air Force and Army pages exist). Guard eligibility depends on Title 10/32 status.

deals.name: Hiring Our Heroes Military Spouse Fellowship
deals.summary: Free 12-week paid fellowship for military spouses
deals.details: Paid 12-week fellowship placing career-ready spouses with employers, at no cost. Spouses of active, Reserve and Guard members of the Army, Marine Corps, Navy, Air Force and Space Force.
deals.howToClaim: Apply through MySECO (rolling applications).
deals.notes: Job offers not guaranteed. Coast Guard not listed.

deals.name: Military spouse federal hiring authority
deals.summary: Noncompetitive federal job hiring for military spouses
deals.details: Federal agencies can hire spouses of active-duty members (and spouses of members 100% disabled or killed on active duty) without the usual competition.
deals.howToClaim: On USAJOBS, filter by the Military spouses hiring path and upload marriage certificate and orders.
deals.notes: Veteran = spouses of 100% disabled veterans only. Remarriage ends widow(er) eligibility.

deals.name: NMFA Military Spouse Scholarship
deals.summary: $500 to $5,000 for spouse education or career costs
deals.details: Awards for tuition, licensing and certification fees, exam costs, clinical supervision hours, or spouse-owned business costs. Spouses of post-9/11 active duty, Guard/Reserve, retirees, 100% disabled veterans and fallen members, all 8 uniformed services.
deals.howToClaim: Apply year-round on militaryfamily.org; reapply each scholarship year (Oct 1 to Sept 30).
deals.notes: Veteran = 100% disabled veterans only. Awards quarterly.

deals.name: MilTax
deals.summary: Free tax software and tax experts for military families
deals.details: Free tax prep and e-filing (federal plus up to 5 state returns) and free help from military tax consultants. Covers active duty, Guard/Reserve, spouses, dependent kids, and family members handling a deployed member's taxes.
deals.howToClaim: Go to MilTax on militaryonesource.mil and verify through DEERS, or call 800-342-9647.
deals.notes: Veterans only within 365 days of separation. Retirees not listed.

deals.name: Military Spouses Residency Relief Act
deals.summary: Spouses can keep the service member's home state for taxes and voting
deals.details: Federal law lets a military spouse claim the same state of legal residence as the service member for state income tax and voting, even if they never lived there.
deals.howToClaim: Talk to your installation legal office or Military OneSource (800-342-9647) before filing state taxes.
deals.notes: Legal right, not a discount. Income like rental property can still be taxed where earned.

deals.name: Kendra Scott
deals.summary: 15% off jewelry with ID.me
deals.details: 15% off eligible purchases for verified ID.me members including the military community.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me and choose Verify with ID.me at checkout.
deals.notes: Page doesn't say whether spouses or veterans qualify, or whether it works in store.

deals.name: Military OneSource non-medical counseling
deals.summary: Free confidential counseling, up to 12 sessions
deals.details: Free, confidential short-term counseling (up to 12 in-person sessions) for service members, spouses, kids ages 6-17 and survivors, for stress, deployment, relationships and parenting.
deals.howToClaim: Call Military OneSource at 800-342-9647, or ask your Military and Family Support Center for a Military and Family Life Counselor.
deals.notes: Guard/Reserve of any activation status. Kids under 18 need parent consent.

deals.name: Yellow Ribbon Reintegration Program
deals.summary: Free pre- and post-deployment events for Guard and Reserve families
deals.details: Events before deployment (about 45 days out) and after (about 90 days after release) cover benefits, money, stress and reintegration. Members may bring a guest; families get resources during deployment and can join virtual events.
deals.howToClaim: Register through the YRRP event system (EventPLUS) or contact your regional YRRP point of contact.
deals.notes: Every Guard and Reserve component runs YRRP.

deals.name: Army Soldier and Family Readiness Groups
deals.summary: Unit support network for families during deployment (Army)
deals.details: Each unit's SFRG links families with the command, shares deployment updates, and connects families to support and resources. Open to single soldiers, single parents and non-traditional families too.
deals.howToClaim: Ask your soldier's unit or the installation Army Community Service for the SFRG leader.
deals.notes: Army (incl. Guard/Reserve units).

deals.name: Navy Family Ombudsman
deals.summary: Command family contact for Navy families (Navy)
deals.details: Each Navy command has a trained volunteer ombudsman who passes information between the command and families and helps with resources, including for Reserve and individual augmentee families.
deals.howToClaim: Find your command's ombudsman in the Navy Ombudsman Registry on ffr.cnic.navy.mil.
deals.notes: Navy only.

deals.name: Air Force Key Spouse Program
deals.summary: Peer support for families before, during and after deployment (Air Force)
deals.details: Unit Key Spouses give peer support, help families through deployments and reintegration, and connect them to base and community resources.
deals.howToClaim: Ask your unit commander, first sergeant or Airman & Family Readiness Center for your Key Spouse.
deals.notes: Department of the Air Force units; Space Force coverage not stated in the article.

deals.name: Marine Corps L.I.N.K.S.
deals.summary: Free classes on Marine Corps life for spouses, kids and parents
deals.details: Marine Corps Family Team Building classes on Corps culture, deployments and moves, with sessions for spouses, kids 6-12, teens, Marines and parents or extended family.
deals.howToClaim: Contact Marine Corps Family Team Building at your installation (MCCS).
deals.notes: Marine Corps only. Cost and online options not stated.

deals.name: Coast Guard Ombudsman Program
deals.summary: Command family contact for Coast Guard families
deals.details: Coast Guard ombudsmen pass information between the command and families, refer families to resources, and advocate for them.
deals.howToClaim: Search the Coast Guard Ombudsman Registry by unit, or contact the nearest Sector or Base ombudsman.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only.

deals.name: EFMP respite care
deals.summary: Respite care for families with special-needs members
deals.details: Families enrolled in the Exceptional Family Member Program may get respite care through their branch. TRICARE ECHO can add up to 16 hours a month of in-home respite.
deals.howToClaim: Contact your installation's EFMP Family Support office or call Military OneSource at 800-342-9647.
deals.notes: Hours and rules differ by branch; Air Force EFMP respite moved to the Department of the Air Force on Oct 1, 2026.

deals.name: Fisher House Hero Miles
deals.summary: Free airline tickets to visit a hospitalized service member
deals.details: Donated frequent flyer miles pay for round-trip flights so family can visit a wounded, ill or injured service member at a medical center, or for the member to travel home on leave.
deals.howToClaim: Request through the service member's caseworker, social worker or casualty office.
deals.notes: Families pay bag and unaccompanied minor fees.

deals.name: Operation Homefront Holiday Meals for Military
deals.summary: Free holiday meals for junior enlisted families
deals.details: Free holiday meal events for E-1 to E-6 active-duty families and post-9/11 wounded, ill or injured members.
deals.howToClaim: Find an event near you on operationhomefront.org and register.
deals.notes: Runs around Thanksgiving and the winter holidays; local events fill up fast.

deals.name: Army Credentialing Assistance (Army COOL)
deals.summary: Up to $2,000 a year for civilian certifications
deals.details: Pays for courses, exams, books, some fees and renewals for industry certifications listed on Army COOL. One new credential goal per fiscal year. Counts toward the same $4,500 yearly cap as TA. Officers (O-1 to O-10) no longer eligible for new goals since March 19, 2026.
deals.howToClaim: Pick a credential on Army COOL, then request funding in ArmyIgnitED.
deals.notes: Army enlisted and warrant officers. Some pilot credentials capped at $1,000. Branch: Army.

deals.name: Army Emergency Relief: Career Skills Program grant
deals.summary: $250 to $1,000 grant for Soldiers in the Army Career Skills Program
deals.details: Retiring and separating Soldiers enrolled in the Army Career Skills Program can get a grant ($250 to $1,000 depending on location) to help with transition costs. Named for retired Lt. Gen. Nathaniel R. Thompson Jr.
deals.howToClaim: See the CSP assistance section on the AER site or your AER office.
deals.notes: Army only. For Soldiers in the transition window. Branch: Army.

deals.name: Army Emergency Relief: Financial Frontline loan credit
deals.summary: Up to $200 off an AER loan for finishing money training
deals.details: Soldiers with an AER loan who watch the Army financial training videos within 90 days of the loan and score 80+ on the test (within 3 tries) get a credit: up to $200 for SPC/CPL and below, up to $100 for SGT and above. Credit cannot exceed the loan balance.
deals.howToClaim: Complete the training and test in AER's Loan Portal.
deals.notes: Army only. Applies only to existing AER loans. Branch: Army.

deals.name: Army Emergency Relief: Survivor Assistance
deals.summary: Grants (and sometimes monthly stipends) for Army survivors
deals.details: Surviving spouses and children of active duty and retired Soldiers can get financial help as grants. Monthly stipends may be available for those in greatest need.
deals.howToClaim: See the Survivor Assistance Program on the AER site or contact AER.
deals.notes: Army survivors only. Branch: Army.

deals.name: Army Emergency Relief: Wounded Warrior Comfort Grant
deals.summary: $1,000 grant when a Soldier is medically evacuated
deals.details: Soldiers medically evacuated from a hostile fire or imminent danger area, peacekeeping operations or training exercises get a $1,000 grant at the time of hospitalization.
deals.howToClaim: Contact your nearest AER office.
deals.notes: Army only. Guard/Reserve eligibility follows the AER Title 10 (30+ days) rule; not restated for this grant. Branch: Army.

deals.name: Army Emergency Relief: child care assistance
deals.summary: Up to $1,500 extra child care help ($500 a month for 3 months)
deals.details: Families already enrolled in Army Fee Assistance can get up to $500 a month for three months on top of that program. A budget showing need is required.
deals.howToClaim: Enroll in Army Fee Assistance first, then request through AER with a budget.
deals.notes: Army only. Requires Army Fee Assistance enrollment. Branch: Army.

deals.name: Army Emergency Relief: zero-interest loans and grants
deals.summary: Interest-free loans or grants for emergencies
deals.details: Army's own aid society covers a long list of needs: rent, food, car repairs, utilities, PCS travel, emergency travel, funerals, dependent dental care, car seats, spouse relicensing and more. Each request is reviewed case by case.
deals.howToClaim: Apply online through the AER Online Assistance Application, or visit the AER office on your installation.
deals.notes: Army only. Guard/Reserve only when on Title 10 orders over 30 days. Retirees, un-remarried surviving spouses and some orphans also eligible. Branch: Army.

deals.name: Army Scholarship Foundation
deals.summary: $1,000 to $10,000 undergraduate scholarships (average about $1,000)
deals.details: For children of current or former Army members and spouses of current Soldiers. One-year awards, can reapply up to 4 years. Family AGI under $160,000, 2.0 GPA, under 24 (no age limit for spouses), U.S. citizens. Deadline April 15. Free to apply.
deals.howToClaim: Apply online by April 15 with a Statement of Good Service.
deals.notes: Army families only. Guard/Reserve not addressed on FAQ. Branch: Army.

deals.name: Army Tuition Assistance (ArmyIgnitED)
deals.summary: Up to $4,500 a year for college classes
deals.details: Pays for off-duty college courses. Since ALARACT 102/2025 the yearly cap is $4,500 and up to 18 semester hours. First-time users must finish ArmyIgnitED training and a decision tool first; supervisor approval required.
deals.howToClaim: Request through ArmyIgnitED after the required training.
deals.notes: Army only. Guard/Reserve on Title 10/32 active duty and drilling TPU Soldiers eligible. TA and Credentialing Assistance share the $4,500 cap. Branch: Army.

deals.name: Better Opportunities for Single Soldiers (BOSS)
deals.summary: Free and low-cost trips, events and recreation for single Soldiers
deals.details: Army MWR program run by and for single Soldiers on each garrison: planned recreation and leisure events, community service projects, and help using unit funds for events.
deals.howToClaim: Contact your garrison BOSS representative or MWR.
deals.notes: Army only. Events and costs vary by installation; national page does not list specific free offers. Branch: Army.

deals.name: Navy COOL credentialing
deals.summary: Navy pays for certification exams and renewals
deals.details: Navy COOL funds the costs of earning and keeping civilian certifications tied to your rating or job, such as exam, application and renewal fees.
deals.howToClaim: Find a credential on Navy COOL and submit a funding request.
deals.notes: Navy only. Dollar limits not shown on the page read; NAVADMIN 136/26 announced an expansion. Branch: Navy.

deals.name: Navy Tuition Assistance and NCPACE
deals.summary: $250 per credit hour, up to 18 semester hours a year
deals.details: Pays for off-duty college or certificate courses at $250 per semester hour, up to 18 semester hours a fiscal year and 120 in a career. NCPACE gives the same kind of courses to Sailors on ships.
deals.howToClaim: Tell your command, do the required training, see a Navy College counselor, then apply in MyNavy Education.
deals.notes: Navy only. The site has a separate SELRES tab; Reserve rules not reviewed. Branch: Navy.

deals.name: Navy-Marine Corps Relief Society: Money Ops
deals.summary: Free game-style money class
deals.details: A team game that teaches saving, debt payoff, reading your LES, retirement savings and spotting predatory lenders.
deals.howToClaim: Find a class through your nearest NMCRS office.
deals.notes: Navy and Marine Corps. Audience not spelled out on page. Branch: Navy and Marine Corps.

deals.name: Navy-Marine Corps Relief Society: Visiting Nurse Program
deals.summary: Free home and virtual visits from registered nurses
deals.details: Registered nurses give free health education and support for pregnancy, newborns and adults, plus classes and support groups, at home or online.
deals.howToClaim: Find a visiting nurse through your nearest NMCRS office.
deals.notes: Navy and Marine Corps families, retirees and widows/widowers. Branch: Navy and Marine Corps.

deals.name: Navy-Marine Corps Relief Society: disaster relief
deals.summary: Money for food, lodging, uniforms and deductibles after a disaster
deals.details: For evacuations, hurricanes, wildfires, floods and household emergencies like fires or major damage. Can cover food, gas, temporary lodging, uniforms, transportation and insurance deductibles.
deals.howToClaim: Make an appointment with your nearest NMCRS office.
deals.notes: Navy and Marine Corps only. Page names active duty and retired; Reserve not restated. Branch: Navy and Marine Corps.

deals.name: Navy-Marine Corps Relief Society: education scholarships and loans
deals.summary: $500 to $3,000 scholarships and up to $4,000 interest-free loans
deals.details: For children (under 23) and spouses of active duty, retired or deceased Sailors and Marines, for trade school through master's degrees. Paid to the school. Next window: Feb 16 to Apr 16, 2027 for the 2027-28 year.
deals.howToClaim: Apply through the NMCRS Education Assistance application during the window.
deals.notes: Navy and Marine Corps only. Need-based (uses FAFSA SAI). Branch: Navy and Marine Corps.

deals.name: Navy-Marine Corps Relief Society: emergency travel
deals.summary: Help paying for emergency leave travel, no appointment needed
deals.details: Walk into any NMCRS office with your military ID and emergency leave papers. After hours or far from an office, the American Red Cross (877-272-7337) acts for NMCRS using NMCRS funds.
deals.howToClaim: Walk in to an NMCRS office, or call the Red Cross at 877-272-7337.
deals.notes: Navy and Marine Corps only. Reservists on 30+ days active duty. Branch: Navy and Marine Corps.

deals.name: Navy-Marine Corps Relief Society: interest-free loans and grants
deals.summary: Interest-free loans or grants for emergencies
deals.details: Help for everyday living costs (food, rent, utilities), car repairs, registration and insurance, PCS moves, medical and dental bills insurance does not cover, and funerals. Also free budgeting help.
deals.howToClaim: Find your nearest NMCRS office and make an appointment.
deals.notes: Navy and Marine Corps only. Reservists only on extended duty of 30+ days. Surviving spouses eligible. Branch: Navy and Marine Corps.

deals.name: Navy-Marine Corps Relief Society: thrift shops
deals.summary: Low-cost household goods, baby gear and discounted uniforms
deals.details: Volunteer-run thrift shops on Navy and Marine Corps bases sell donated clothes, furniture, baby gear and dishes cheaply. Discounted uniforms for active duty and retirees. Hours vary by base.
deals.howToClaim: Check your nearest NMCRS location for thrift shop hours.
deals.notes: Navy and Marine Corps families. Base access needed. Branch: Navy and Marine Corps.

deals.name: Navy-Marine Corps Relief Society: uniform lockers
deals.summary: Gently used Navy and Marine Corps uniforms at reduced prices
deals.details: Inspected donated uniforms (dress, working, PT, flight suits, covers, boots). Priority to active duty. Not every office has one.
deals.howToClaim: Find the uniform locker nearest you on the NMCRS site.
deals.notes: Navy and Marine Corps only. Branch: Navy and Marine Corps.

deals.name: U.S. Naval Community College
deals.summary: Free naval-focused associate degrees and certificates
deals.details: Navy-run online college that turns military training into credit toward associate degrees, starting with a 5-course Naval Studies Certificate. Navy HR says it does not use your Tuition Assistance.
deals.howToClaim: Apply on the USNCC website.
deals.notes: Enlisted Sailors, Marines and Coast Guard (active duty) plus Coast Guard Reservists. Navy HR page says open to active duty E-1 to E-9. Branch: Navy and Marine Corps.

deals.name: MCCS free barracks Wi-Fi
deals.summary: Free Wi-Fi up to 100 Mbps in participating barracks
deals.details: MCCS and Boingo give eligible Marines free filtered Wi-Fi in participating barracks, up to 100 Mbps down / 20 Mbps up, up to 3 devices, no monthly cost.
deals.howToClaim: Inside a participating barracks, join the MCCS Free WiFi network and create a free account.
deals.notes: Page found is for MCLB Albany. Other Marine bases may differ; confirm which barracks participate before listing nationwide. Branch: Marine Corps.

deals.name: Marine Corps COOL credentialing
deals.summary: Marine Corps pays for approved certifications
deals.details: Marine Corps COOL lets Marines request funding for civilian certifications linked to their job.
deals.howToClaim: Submit a funding request on Marine Corps COOL.
deals.notes: Marine Corps only. Limits not shown on the page read. Branch: Marine Corps.

deals.name: Marine Corps Scholarship Foundation
deals.summary: Need-based college scholarships for children of Marines
deals.details: Scholarships for undergraduate and career/technical programs for children of active duty, Reserve, veteran or fallen Marines (and Navy corpsmen, chaplains and RPs who served with Marine units). Family AGI limit $134,000 (2025 tax year), 2.0 GPA. Children of the fallen get $30,000 over 4 years; children of the wounded up to $40,000.
deals.howToClaim: Apply online at mcsf.org during the application window.
deals.notes: Marine Corps families (plus Navy corpsmen/chaplains/RPs attached to Marine units). Veterans need honorable discharge. Branch: Marine Corps.

deals.name: Marine Corps Tuition Assistance
deals.summary: Up to $4,500 a year for college classes
deals.details: Covers tuition at $250 per semester hour up to $4,500 a fiscal year for active duty Marines. Must keep a C average. First-timers complete a Personal Readiness Seminar, career surveys and a TA brief.
deals.howToClaim: Complete the first-time steps, then apply in the Web TA portal through your MCCS Education Center.
deals.notes: Marine Corps only. Same policy applies Corps-wide (NAVMC 1560.25). Branch: Marine Corps.

deals.name: Air & Space Forces Aid Society: Bee Arnold Spouse Tuition Program
deals.summary: Up to $2,500 for spouse job training or part-time college
deals.details: Pays for short (3 to 12 week) job certifications or part-time degree study for spouses, such as medical coding, dental assistant, pharmacy tech, real estate license. Recipients can also get an Education Childcare Grant.
deals.howToClaim: Apply once a year on the AFAS portal under Community Programs with proof of enrollment and orders.
deals.notes: Spouses of active duty Air Force and Space Force (or Guard/Reserve on extended active duty / Title 32 full-time). Branch: Air Force and Space Force.

deals.name: Air & Space Forces Aid Society: Car Seat Program
deals.summary: One-time $200 toward a car seat or booster
deals.details: One-time payment to help buy a car or booster seat for Airmen and Guardians in grades E-1 to E-5.
deals.howToClaim: Apply on the AFAS portal.
deals.notes: Active duty Air Force and Space Force E-1 to E-5 only. Branch: Air Force and Space Force.

deals.name: Air & Space Forces Aid Society: Child Care for PCS
deals.summary: $200 per child (up to $1,000) for child care during a move
deals.details: Child care money during a PCS, retirement, Palace Chase or separation move: $200 per child age 12 and under, capped at $1,000 per household, usable at any provider, paid by Zelle or ACH. Apply within 60 days of arrival or departure.
deals.howToClaim: Apply on the AFAS portal with your military ID and orders listing the children.
deals.notes: Air Force and Space Force only. Guard/Reserve only on Title 10 orders over 15 days with a PCS order. Retirees at departure only. Branch: Air Force and Space Force.

deals.name: Air & Space Forces Aid Society: Financial Lift-Off
deals.summary: Free money course plus up to $500 off an AFAS loan
deals.details: Free self-paced online course on budgeting, saving and debt, built with the USAA Educational Foundation. Finishing it earns a one-time $500 credit on an AFAS loan received on or after Jan 1, 2026 ($250 for loans May to Dec 2025).
deals.howToClaim: Enroll free on the AFAS Financial Lift-Off page using the same name and email as your loan.
deals.notes: Air Force and Space Force. Loan credit excludes government-shutdown loans. Branch: Air Force and Space Force.

deals.name: Air & Space Forces Aid Society: Hap Arnold Education Grant
deals.summary: Need-based college grant for kids and spouses
deals.details: The General Henry H. Arnold Education Grant helps children (under 24) and spouses pay for college. Amount depends on need (FAFSA SAI) and cost of attendance. 2026-27 is closed; reopens January 2027.
deals.howToClaim: Apply on the AFAS site when the window opens in January.
deals.notes: Air Force and Space Force only. Guard/Reserve only on extended active duty or Title 32 full-time. Branch: Air Force and Space Force.

deals.name: Air & Space Forces Aid Society: Merit and Grit Scholarships
deals.summary: At least 20 scholarships of $5,000 for incoming freshmen
deals.details: For children of active duty and retired Airmen and Guardians, chosen on GPA or on overcoming a challenge. You are considered automatically by finishing the Hap Arnold Grant application.
deals.howToClaim: Complete the Hap Arnold Grant application; AFAS contacts finalists in June.
deals.notes: Air Force and Space Force only. Branch: Air Force and Space Force.

deals.name: Air & Space Forces Aid Society: Supplemental Education Loan
deals.summary: Interest-free $1,000 loan for books and fees
deals.details: Up to $1,000 per full-time undergraduate student for books, fees and supplies, repaid over 12 months by allotment.
deals.howToClaim: AFAS sends applications in the fall to students who completed the Hap Arnold application.
deals.notes: Air Force and Space Force only. Branch: Air Force and Space Force.

deals.name: Air & Space Forces Aid Society: emergency loans and grants
deals.summary: Interest-free loans or grants for emergencies
deals.details: Covers rent and utilities, adoption, medical and dental, car and home repairs, funerals, pet PCS costs, overseas car rentals, vehicle shipping, pay problems and more. A budget is required; paid by Zelle or ACH.
deals.howToClaim: Apply on the AFAS online portal (portal.afas.org).
deals.notes: Air Force and Space Force only. Guard and Reserve eligible regardless of duty status. Retirees limited. The society now goes by Air & Space Forces Aid Society. Branch: Air Force and Space Force.

deals.name: Air & Space Forces Aid Society: emergency travel
deals.summary: Help paying for emergency leave travel
deals.details: Request through the American Red Cross (877-272-7337). Starts as an interest-free loan; may be converted to a grant for death or serious illness of a parent or sibling (yours or your spouse's).
deals.howToClaim: Call the American Red Cross at 877-272-7337 and say you need financial help.
deals.notes: Air Force and Space Force only. Branch: Air Force and Space Force.

deals.name: Air & Space Forces Aid Society: free GED for spouses and kids
deals.summary: Free online GED program for spouses and dependents
deals.details: Self-paced online GED prep with an advisor, 24/7 tutoring, practice tests, and exam vouchers for those testing overseas. Offered with GEDWorks.
deals.howToClaim: Email the AFAS Education Team (address on the page) to ask to enroll.
deals.notes: Families of Air Force and Space Force members, including traditional Guard/Reserve and retirees. Branch: Air Force and Space Force.

deals.name: Air Force COOL credentialing
deals.summary: Air Force pays for approved certifications
deals.details: AF COOL funds civilian certifications for Airmen and Guardians.
deals.howToClaim: Access AF COOL with a CAC through the CCAF page.
deals.notes: Public AF COOL page returned an access error; CCAF page lists it as CAC-only. Details not verified. Branch: Air Force and Space Force.

deals.name: Air Force and Space Force Tuition Assistance
deals.summary: Up to $4,500 a year for college classes
deals.details: Pays up to $250 per semester hour, capped at $4,500 a fiscal year, for degree courses. Supervisor approval in AFVEC 7 to 45 days before class. GPA 2.0 undergrad / 3.0 grad. Officers owe extra service time.
deals.howToClaim: Request in the Air Force Virtual Education Center (AFVEC).
deals.notes: Air Force and Space Force only. Guard/Reserve on Title 10 or 32 active duty. Branch: Air Force and Space Force.

deals.name: Community College of the Air Force
deals.summary: Free associate degree built from your military training
deals.details: Federally chartered college for enlisted Airmen and Guardians (active, Guard and Reserve). Basic training, tech school and PME count toward a 64-credit Associate of Applied Science; 69 programs.
deals.howToClaim: Talk to your base Education Center and track progress in AFVEC.
deals.notes: Air Force and Space Force enlisted only. Civilian general-education credits may cost money unless covered by TA or CLEP/DSST. Branch: Air Force and Space Force.

deals.name: Coast Guard COOL credentialing
deals.summary: Coast Guard pays approved credentialing fees
deals.details: Coast Guard COOL pays approved fees for civilian certifications tied to your rating.
deals.howToClaim: Submit a funding request on Coast Guard COOL.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only. Limits not shown on the page read. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Foundation scholarships
deals.summary: College and trade school scholarships for Coast Guard kids
deals.details: Scholarships for college-age children of active duty, retired and active Reserve Coast Guard members. Fallen Heroes scholarships cover 100% of college and living costs for children of fallen members. 2026 window was Feb 1 to Apr 1.
deals.howToClaim: Apply on the Coast Guard Foundation website during the Feb to Apr window.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only. Award amounts not listed per student (2025: 255 awards, $925,000 total). Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: Adoption Home Study Grant
deals.summary: Up to $3,000 back for an adoption home study
deals.details: Reimburses the required home study cost when adopting.
deals.howToClaim: Start with your CGMA Representative and apply online.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only (including retirees and Auxiliary). Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: Breastmilk Shipment Grant
deals.summary: Up to $750 a year to ship breastmilk home
deals.details: Covers shipping and equipment costs for nursing parents traveling for duty or work. Up to $750 per family each 12 months. Active duty is now covered by the government, so this is for other eligible members and spouses.
deals.howToClaim: Apply online with your CG ID, receipts and orders or proof of work travel.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only. Mainly Reservists, civilians and spouses since active duty is government-covered. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: Education Advocate Grant
deals.summary: Up to $500 to hire a certified education advocate
deals.details: Reimburses a certified education advocate to help with a child's first IEP or IFSP, or a new one after moving to a new school district.
deals.howToClaim: Apply online with your CG ID, the advocate's receipt and PCS orders.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: Emergency Travel Loan
deals.summary: Interest-free loan up to $6,000 for emergency travel
deals.details: Covers travel, food and lodging when a family member is seriously ill or dies.
deals.howToClaim: Apply online with your Coast Guard ID, cost estimates and a command statement or travel orders.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: Family Building Benefit
deals.summary: Free fertility and family-building nurse support through WIN
deals.details: Access to WIN Nurse Care Advocates 24/7 for fertility and family-building questions, education and guidance.
deals.howToClaim: Fill out the WIN enrollment application linked on the CGMA page.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: Financial Education Childcare Grant
deals.summary: Up to $500 for child care while you take a money class
deals.details: Pays for child care so you and your spouse can attend financial education or counseling together.
deals.howToClaim: Apply online with proof you attended and a child care receipt or signed note.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: Maternity Uniform Grant
deals.summary: Up to $300 for officer maternity uniforms
deals.details: Helps active duty and Reserve officers buy required maternity uniforms (enlisted members get a clothing allowance instead).
deals.howToClaim: Apply online with your CG ID and receipts from the last 12 months.
deals.notes: Coast Guard officers only. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: PCS Childcare Grant
deals.summary: $150 per child for child care during a PCS move
deals.details: For child care within 60 days before leaving or 60 days after reporting. Can be a daycare or a friend or neighbor (not a family member). Kids 12 and under, or special needs children of any age. Apply within 6 months.
deals.howToClaim: Apply online with your CG ID, a receipt or signed provider note, and PCS orders (ADOS orders for Reservists).
deals.notes: Coast Guard only. Reservists only on ADOS orders. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: Quick Loan
deals.summary: Interest-free loan up to $1,500 with less paperwork
deals.details: Fast interest-free loan for urgent essential needs, arranged through your commanding officer or officer-in-charge. Up to two per 12 months; not available if you already owe CGMA.
deals.howToClaim: Talk to your command or local CGMA Representative; apply online with your Coast Guard ID and bills or estimates.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only (also CG civilians and PHS officers). CGMA has many more loan types for specific needs (rent, car repair, PCS, pets and more) on its programs page. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: Respite Care Grant
deals.summary: Short-term paid respite care (up to 3 months)
deals.details: Short-term help paying for breaks for caregivers of a family member enrolled in the CG Special Needs Program with a profound disability or serious illness.
deals.howToClaim: Start with your Family Resource Specialist at the local Work-Life office, then apply online.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: Special Needs Grant
deals.summary: Up to $3,000 every 5 years for special needs costs
deals.details: Reimburses services or items for dependents enrolled in the Coast Guard Special Needs Program, up to $3,000 every 60 months.
deals.howToClaim: Apply online or with form CGMA-05 through your CGMA Rep, with receipts, a doctor's document and Special Needs Program enrollment.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only. Page text names active duty; the side panel also lists Reserves. Needs confirming. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: Supplemental Education Grant
deals.summary: Grant for school fees, books and supplies
deals.details: Helps Coast Guard members, spouses and children with fees, books, supplies and equipment for qualifying programs. Once-a-year window (June 1 to Sept 30 in 2026). Approval not guaranteed.
deals.howToClaim: Apply online during the summer window or through your CGMA Rep.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only. Grant amount not shown in the part of the page read. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: disaster grants and loans
deals.summary: Flat $250 to $500 food-loss grant plus up to $2,500 for lost belongings
deals.details: After a named storm, 24+ hour power outage or mandatory evacuation: food-loss grant with no receipts ($500 with dependents, $250 without). Personal property grant up to $2,500. Also loans and grants for evacuation, temporary housing and home or vehicle repair.
deals.howToClaim: Contact your CGMA Representative or apply online.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only. Amounts are the 2026 hurricane-season rules on the page. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance: free tutoring (Tutor.com)
deals.summary: Free 24/7 tutoring and SAT/ACT prep, paid for by CGMA
deals.details: CGMA funds Tutor.com/military for Coast Guard families: on-demand online tutoring in 150+ subjects, test prep and career help.
deals.howToClaim: Set up an account at Tutor.com/military.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only via CGMA. This is the Coast Guard funding path. Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Coast Guard Tuition Assistance
deals.summary: Up to $4,500 a year for college classes
deals.details: Pays up to $250 per semester hour, capped at $4,500 a fiscal year. Must pass with C (undergrad) or B (grad) or repay. Apply 7 to 90 days before class starts.
deals.howToClaim: Apply in MyCG Ed and contact your Education Services Officer.
deals.notes: Coast Guard only (active duty, SELRES, and permanent CG civilians). Branch: Coast Guard.

deals.name: Armed Forces Recreation Centers Black Friday sale
deals.summary: Up to 25% off rooms at all four AFRC resorts
deals.details: Black Friday sale at Shades of Green, Hale Koa, Edelweiss and Dragon Hill for 2027 stays. Ends December 2 or when rooms sell out.
deals.howToClaim: Book on any AFRC resort website before Dec 2.
deals.notes: Seasonal, expires 2026-12-02. Branch: Army (all branches can use).

deals.name: Dragon Hill Lodge (Seoul, Korea)
deals.summary: Military-only hotel in Seoul, stays from $99 a night
deals.details: Armed Forces Recreation Center hotel in Seoul with military rates and tour packages.
deals.howToClaim: Book at dragonhilllodge.com.
deals.notes: Run by the Army for all branches. Eligible: active duty, Guard/Reserve, retirees, families; Shades of Green, Hale Koa and Dragon Hill also allow Purple Heart, former POW and service-connected disabled veterans with a VHIC (not Edelweiss). Branch: Army (all branches can use).

deals.name: Dragon Hill Lodge free holiday stay for E-1 to E-6
deals.summary: Free holiday stay in Seoul for junior enlisted
deals.details: Eligible E-1 to E-6 guests can get a complimentary stay on select December dates.
deals.howToClaim: See the Learn More link on dragonhilllodge.com and reserve.
deals.notes: Seasonal (December 2026). Exact dates and rules not read; check before listing. Branch: Army (all branches can use).

deals.name: Edelweiss Lodge and Resort (Garmisch, Germany)
deals.summary: Military-only Alpine resort in Bavaria
deals.details: Armed Forces Recreation Center resort in the Bavarian Alps with military rates.
deals.howToClaim: Book at edelweisslodgeandresort.com.
deals.notes: Run by the Army for all branches. Eligible: active duty, Guard/Reserve, retirees, families; Shades of Green, Hale Koa and Dragon Hill also allow Purple Heart, former POW and service-connected disabled veterans with a VHIC (not Edelweiss). Disabled-veteran access does not apply here. Branch: Army (all branches can use).

deals.name: Hale Koa Hotel (Waikiki, Hawaii)
deals.summary: Military-only beachfront hotel in Waikiki
deals.details: Armed Forces Recreation Center hotel on Waikiki Beach with military rates. Currently also running a 20% off room promotion.
deals.howToClaim: Book at halekoa.com.
deals.notes: Run by the Army for all branches. Eligible: active duty, Guard/Reserve, retirees, families; Shades of Green, Hale Koa and Dragon Hill also allow Purple Heart, former POW and service-connected disabled veterans with a VHIC (not Edelweiss). 20% promo terms not read in detail. Branch: Army (all branches can use).

deals.name: Shades of Green Resort (Walt Disney World)
deals.summary: Military-only resort on Disney property with discounted park tickets
deals.details: Armed Forces Recreation Center resort at Walt Disney World with military room rates and an on-site ticket office selling Disney military promotional tickets.
deals.howToClaim: Book on shadesofgreen.org; order tickets by web form or at the ticket office with military ID.
deals.notes: Run by the Army for all branches. Eligible: active duty, Guard/Reserve, retirees, families; Shades of Green, Hale Koa and Dragon Hill also allow Purple Heart, former POW and service-connected disabled veterans with a VHIC (not Edelweiss). This is the resort. Branch: Army (all branches can use).

deals.name: Army & Air Force Exchange: You Made the Grade
deals.summary: $10 to $20 gift card for good grades each grading period
deals.details: Students in grades 1 to 12 with a B average or better get a gift card each grading period ($20 for straight A, $10 for B average), a coupon sheet, and entry into a twice-yearly sweepstakes. Homeschool and non-traditional grades accepted with paperwork.
deals.howToClaim: Bring a military ID and report card (or school affirmation) to your local Exchange.
deals.notes: AAFES own page not reached. Run by AAFES (Army and Air Force), open to authorized shoppers. Branch: Army and Air Force (all branches can use).

deals.name: Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) price match guarantee
deals.summary: Matches final prices at U.S. stores and major online retailers
deals.details: MCX matches the final sale price of identical new items at any U.S. brick-and-mortar store or listed online sellers (Amazon, Best Buy, Target, Walmart and others). Excludes clearance, marketplaces, fine jewelry, gas and more.
deals.howToClaim: Show the competitor price at the MCX register.
deals.notes: Run by the Marine Corps, open to all authorized exchange shoppers. Branch: Marine Corps (all branches can use).

deals.name: Navy Exchange (NEX): tax-free shopping, price match and free shipping
deals.summary: No sales tax, price match, free shipping over $49.95
deals.details: NEX stores and mynavyexchange.com are always sales-tax free, match any retailer's advertised price, and ship free on orders of $49.95+ (or with a MILITARY STAR card). No price matching Nov 26 to Dec 5, 2026.
deals.howToClaim: Shop at a NEX store or mynavyexchange.com. Honorably discharged veterans can shop online only.
deals.notes: Run by the Navy but open to all branches. Veterans: online only. Holiday price-match blackout from the NEX FAQ page. Branch: Navy (all branches can use).

deals.name: Navy Lodge PCS scratch-off discount
deals.summary: 10% to 100% off your room on a PCS move
deals.details: Guests on PCS orders get a scratch-off card worth 10%, 15%, 25% or 100% off the room rate (up to 20 nights) at any continental U.S. Navy Lodge. Card available at the base personal property office, NEX customer service, or by calling 800-628-9466.
deals.howToClaim: Get the card before checkout and hand it to the front desk to scratch at checkout.
deals.notes: Run by the Navy; Navy Lodges are open to all branches. PCS guests only, CONUS only, no expiration listed. Branch: Navy (all branches can use).

deals.name: Colorado National Guard Tuition Waiver
deals.summary: Up to 100% of in-state tuition at Colorado public colleges
deals.details: Covers undergraduate and graduate credit courses, full- or part-time, fall, spring and summer, at state-approved public colleges. From July 1, 2026 (HB26-1386), other aid and Federal TA are applied first and the waiver covers the rest. FAFSA or CASFA required.
deals.howToClaim: Apply on the DMVA site during the window (Fall: Jun 1-20, Spring: Nov 1-20, Summer: Apr 1-20).
deals.notes: Colorado Army and Air National Guard members only. Branch: National Guard (Colorado).

deals.name: Florida National Guard Educational Dollars for Duty (EDD)
deals.summary: Up to 100% of in-state public tuition
deals.details: State tuition help for Florida Guard members for technical certificates, associate, bachelor's and (if approved before Jan 1, 2026) master's degrees, plus licensing and certification exams. Private schools paid at the state resident rate. Books may be refunded if money is left.
deals.howToClaim: Apply through the EDD portal (edd.dma.myflorida.com).
deals.notes: Florida National Guard only. State benefit, not an entitlement (FY26 budget about $5.2M). Branch: National Guard (Florida).

deals.name: Georgia National Guard Service Cancelable Loan
deals.summary: State loan for tuition that can be forgiven through Guard service
deals.details: Georgia Student Finance Commission program for Georgia National Guard members toward undergraduate or graduate tuition.
deals.howToClaim: See the official program page.
deals.notes: Georgia National Guard only. Award amounts and service terms are on sub-pages not reviewed. Branch: National Guard (Georgia).

deals.name: New York Recruitment Incentive and Retention Program (RIRP)
deals.summary: Tuition paid up to SUNY rates
deals.details: Pays undergraduate tuition up to SUNY rates per semester for members of the New York Army and Air National Guard and Naval Militia in good standing, 6+ credits, NY resident 186 days. Competitive. Must file FAFSA and TAP first.
deals.howToClaim: Submit DMNA Form 96-1, FAFSA summary, TAP award and transcript to your unit by Aug 15 (fall) or Dec 15 (spring).
deals.notes: New York Guard and Naval Militia only. New application every semester. Branch: National Guard (New York).

deals.name: Utah National Guard State Tuition Waiver
deals.summary: Base tuition waived at Utah public colleges for full-time students
deals.details: Waives base tuition (not fees) for one or two semesters at Utah public colleges and universities for Guard members working on a first associate or bachelor's degree, 12 to 18 credits, fall and spring only. 2.0 GPA (2.75 at USU).
deals.howToClaim: Apply Jan 1 to Apr 30 for the next school year at guard-statetuition.utah.gov with transcript and a short essay.
deals.notes: Utah National Guard only. State Tuition Assistance (STA) can help with fees. Branch: National Guard (Utah).

deals.name: Active&Fit Direct (USAA members)
deals.summary: $28 a month gym membership for USAA members
deals.details: USAA members can join Active&Fit Direct for $28 a month at their choice of 12,800+ standard gyms, or pay more for discounted premium studios. No long-term contract, gyms can be switched or cancelled online, and a spouse can be added. USAA says its $28 enrollment fee is waived through 12/31/26.
deals.howToClaim: See USAA's Active&Fit Direct page.
deals.notes: Active&Fit Direct isn't open to the public; access comes through a sponsor such as USAA or the Air & Space Forces Association (afa.org member benefits). USAA's page names USAA members only, not specific groups, so groups follow USAA's own membership rules. Active&Fit Direct's FAQ lists a 2-month minimum before month-to-month. Its site says a $45 multi-gym option starts 1/1/27.

deals.name: ExpertVoice
deals.summary: Free pro-deal access: up to 60% off 650+ brands
deals.details: ExpertVoice is a free platform that unlocks pro pricing from many brands (outdoor, fitness, apparel, tech and more) for verified service members. Its military page lists discounts of up to 60% off MSRP, and deeper discounts can depend on your affiliation.
deals.howToClaim: Create a free ExpertVoice account and verify military status by uploading a document.
deals.notes: Platform with many brands; each brand sets its own pricing and access. Page says all members of the armed forces, veterans and spouses qualify. Accepted documents include an LES, ERB, Veteran card or official military status letter. Approval can take up to 3 business days, and uploaded files are deleted within 60 days.

deals.name: Guidefitter
deals.summary: Free access to military pro pricing from hundreds of outdoor brands
deals.details: Guidefitter is a free platform for military pro deals on hunting, fishing and outdoor gear from hundreds of brands. Pricing is set by each brand, and some brands may ask for extra proof before approving you for their program.
deals.howToClaim: Create a free Guidefitter account, choose your military status and send verification documents.
deals.notes: Platform with many brands; acceptance into each brand's pro program isn't guaranteed. Page names active duty, Reserve, National Guard, retired and veterans; spouses aren't mentioned. Guidefitter reviews documents itself: active duty and Reserve use a recent LES (under 2 months old) or a .mil email, and veterans use a DD-214 or similar. Documents are deleted after review.

deals.name: ASICS
deals.summary: 25% off full-price footwear and 30% off full-price clothing and accessories
deals.details: For active duty (including spouses and dependents), Reservists, retirees and veterans. Verify online or in store through ASICS; applies to qualifying full-price items only, not sale items. In stores, show the QR code ASICS emails you.
deals.howToClaim: Verify status in your OneASICS account, then apply the discount in your bag or show the emailed QR code in store

deals.name: Black Rifle Coffee Company
deals.summary: 20% off your first Coffee Club subscription
deals.details: For current and former U.S. military. Verify with ID.me and log in to a BRCC account; the discount applies at checkout.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me on the BRCC page

deals.name: Budget
deals.summary: Up to 35% off Pay Now car rentals with WeSalute+
deals.details: For veterans, active duty, Guard, Reserve and immediate family. Requires a paid WeSalute+ subscription; add the BCD number when booking. Blackout dates and non-participating locations apply.
deals.howToClaim: Join WeSalute+, then enter its BCD number when booking a Pay Now rate
deals.notes: Needs a paid WeSalute+ subscription.

deals.name: Discount Tire
deals.summary: 5% off tires and wheels
deals.details: For active duty, veterans and reserves, verified with ID.me. Applies after other discounts and can stack with most deals, but not with the Discount Tire credit card 5% savings.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me online or in store

deals.name: Disney Cruise Line
deals.summary: Special military rates on select sailings, plus $250 onboard credit on select 2026 sailings
deals.details: For active or retired military, including Guard, Reserve, Coast Guard, Space Force, PHS and NOAA Corps. Spouses qualify with their own valid military ID. New bookings only, one stateroom per member per sailing, up to 50 staterooms per category. Covers voyage fare only, not taxes, gratuities or Port Adventures, and can't be combined with other offers. The $250 onboard credit is for select Disney Wish and Disney Dream sailings from Florida (categories 04A–11C, no Concierge or suites) and applies to sailings by Dec 31, 2026.
deals.howToClaim: Book an eligible sailing at the military rate
deals.notes: The $250 credit ends with sailings on Dec 31, 2026, so remove it from the summary after that. Military rates themselves are ongoing. Veterans who aren't retired don't qualify.

deals.name: Disney+
deals.summary: 25% off the annual Disney+ Premium plan through the Exchange
deals.details: For current Exchange members (service members, veterans and families). New or returning subscribers only; current subscribers can't redeem. Annual Premium plan only, not monthly or bundles, and can't be combined with other promos. Renews each year at 25% off. Available in the U.S. or on base internet in the UK, Puerto Rico, Germany and Japan.
deals.howToClaim: Sign up through the Exchange (shopmyexchange.com)

deals.name: Ford
deals.summary: Military cash reward on a new Ford or Lincoln
deals.details: Cash reward toward buying or leasing an eligible new Ford or Lincoln. Amount depends on your ZIP code; confirm status with ID.me to get a certificate.
deals.howToClaim: Enter your ZIP code, verify with ID.me, then take the certificate to the dealer

deals.name: General Motors
deals.summary: $500 off select new Chevrolet, Buick, GMC and Cadillac vehicles
deals.details: For active duty, Reserve, Guard, veterans and retirees of the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps and Coast Guard; participants can sponsor their spouse. Get an authorization number before delivery; take delivery by Jan 4, 2027.
deals.howToClaim: Get an authorization number on the GM site and give it to a participating dealer
deals.notes: Space Force not named on the page. Extra $500 bonus cash on a new 2026 Chevy Colorado through 11/30/26 (temporary, not in the summary).

deals.name: Honda
deals.summary: $500 off a new Honda
deals.details: For eligible military members, retirees, veterans and their families through Honda Financial Services.
deals.howToClaim: Ask the dealer about the Honda Military Appreciation offer when financing or leasing

deals.name: Hulu
deals.summary: 25% off Hulu (With Ads) monthly through the Exchange
deals.details: For new and existing Hulu subscribers billed directly by Hulu who have a current Exchange membership (service members, veterans and dependents). Hulu (With Ads) only; switching to Premium, a bundle or Live TV drops the discount. Add-ons are allowed at full price. Can't combine with other promo pricing.
deals.howToClaim: Sign up through the Exchange (shopmyexchange.com)

deals.name: L.L.Bean
deals.summary: 10% off your order
deals.details: For active duty, veterans, retirees, reservists and family members in the same household. Verify with SheerID; each code works for five orders.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with SheerID on the page, then use the code at checkout

deals.name: Lexus
deals.summary: $1,000 military rebate on a new Lexus
deals.details: For active duty, inactive reserve, retirees, veterans within two years of discharge, and household members including Gold Star families. Use toward any new Lexus bought or leased through your dealer and Lexus Financial Services. Verification required.
deals.howToClaim: Verify on the Lexus page, then ask your dealer
deals.notes: Veterans only within two years of discharge.

deals.name: Luna Grill
deals.summary: 10% off with military ID
deals.details: Luna Grill's FAQ says military get 10% off with a valid military ID. All locations are company owned.
deals.howToClaim: Show military ID when ordering

deals.name: Motel 6
deals.summary: 10% off best available rates
deals.details: For active and retired military, veterans and their families at participating Motel 6 locations in the U.S. and Canada.
deals.howToClaim: Book the Military Rate on Motel 6's site
deals.notes: Participating locations only.

deals.name: Paramount+
deals.summary: 50% off any Paramount+ plan for as long as you stay subscribed
deals.details: For active duty, retirees, reservists and National Guard, veterans, dependents and spouses, verified through SheerID. Sign up in a web browser (not the app). Current subscribers must cancel and re-subscribe through the military link. The discount lasts for the life of the subscription.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with SheerID through the link in the help article

deals.name: Regal Cinemas
deals.summary: Military ticket pricing at participating theatres
deals.details: For active and retired military; pricing set by each location. Buy at the box office and show ID. Regal lists the participating theatres on its page.
deals.howToClaim: Show military ID at the box office of a participating theatre
deals.notes: Price varies by theatre.

deals.name: San Diego Zoo
deals.summary: Free admission for active duty; 10% off 1-Day Pass for spouses and dependents
deals.details: Active duty get free entry to the San Diego Zoo and Safari Park with a CAC or Uniformed Services ID. Spouses and dependents get 10% off a 1-Day Pass, even without the service member. Safari Park parking and special events are not included.
deals.howToClaim: Show your ID at the gate or ticket window
deals.notes: Free entry covers active duty plus Reserve components (Ready Reserve, National Guard) and service academy cadets. Guests age 3+ with them need tickets. No park discount for retirees or veterans; they can buy discounted tickets through a base MWR ticket office.

deals.name: Showcase Cinemas
deals.summary: $8 movie tickets; $6 matinees and kids
deals.details: For active duty and dependents at all locations except Showcase SuperLux in Chestnut Hill, MA. Show active service ID at the box office.
deals.howToClaim: Show active duty ID at the box office

deals.name: SIXT
deals.summary: Up to 15% off car rentals
deals.details: For active military and veterans with a valid ID. No code needed; book through SIXT's military page and the discount applies automatically.
deals.howToClaim: Book through the Book Discount button on SIXT's military page

deals.name: Timberland
deals.summary: 10% off your order
deals.details: For active duty, retirees, reservists, veterans and spouses/dependents. Verify with SheerID; not all products qualify.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with SheerID on the page, then use the code at checkout

deals.name: AMC Theatres
deals.summary: Military ticket discount at participating theatres
deals.details: AMC lists the theatres that offer military discounts on its participating theatres page. Amount and rules vary by theatre.
deals.howToClaim: Show military ID at the box office of a participating theatre
deals.notes: Price and eligibility vary by theatre.

deals.name: TULA Skincare
deals.summary: 20% off skincare
deals.details: For military (also medical providers, students and teachers). Verify with ID.me on TULA's discount page.
deals.howToClaim: Verify with ID.me on the TULA page

deals.name: UGG
deals.summary: 10% off one order a month
deals.details: Military personnel verify through SheerID (documents may be needed, usually within 48 hours) to get a promo code, usable once a month.
deals.howToClaim: Verify on UGG's promotions page, then use the promo code at checkout

deals.name: Universal Orlando Resort
deals.summary: 2027 Military Freedom Pass from $235, plus up to 40% off Universal hotels
deals.details: Sold only at base ITT/MWR (Authorized Military Ticket & Travel) offices with a DEERS photo ID. For active duty, Reserve, Guard, retirees and their spouses, 100% disabled veterans, and DoD civilians (no hotel discount for DoD civilians). Freedom Pass is good through 12/23/2027 with blockout dates 12/25/2026–1/3/2027 and 3/22–3/29/2027; buy up to 6, and one must be for the service member. Hotels: 40% off the Flexible Rate at Cabana Bay, up to 30% at other Universal hotels.
deals.howToClaim: Buy at a participating base ITT/MWR ticket office
deals.notes: Veterans only if 100% disabled. Freedom Pass price and dates are for 2027; update when the 2028 pass comes out. Volcano Bay closed until about 4/1/2027.

deals.name: Volkswagen
deals.summary: Military lease program for service members stationed outside the U.S.
deals.details: Through Military AutoSource for active duty, DoD civilians and diplomats stationed abroad. Choose any VW or special order; delivery in Europe or at a U.S. dealer.
deals.howToClaim: Contact Military AutoSource through VW's Military Program page
deals.notes: For people stationed outside the U.S. only.
